title: Original hydric-soil and one-percent floodplain criterion sources

query_domain.study_id: Original reporting geometry union the full original geometry of every selected parcel; exact parcel source/filter/native IDs and reporting/grid binding retained.
query_domain.domain: Explicit original retained polygon source selection, including its layer and exact typed where filter.
query_domain.analysis: Source queries use the actual union in EPSG:4326; parcel areas and criterion intersections use the retained projected study CRS.
query_domain.relationship: Reporting-footprint and full-parcel metric definitions remain separate in parcel_criteria.

reuse_priority: Explicit completed native soil capture root
Latest imported original vector with SOIL_K_NATIVE, SOIL_MAPUNITS, SSURGO_MAPUNITS or MUPOLYGON role
geometry.actual_current_capture: source_tools.soil_sources Sda(capture_root,resume=True), geometry-capture.json tiles/pages, original WGS84 GeometryWkb and MapUnitKey/MuPolygonKey/AOI identifiers
geometry.spatial_queries: Exact native key count then exact ID list; split tiles before the published row limit; preserve whole original positive-intersection polygons.
geometry.aoi_fragments: Keep original tile/request/AOI identifiers. Parcel calculations use polygon unions so overlapping source fragments do not multiply area.
geometry.extension: When original queried AOI masks are retained, query only the actual selected-domain difference; preserve the returned original fragments and native identities. Explicit original source filters remain selected.
geometry.query_coverage_source: soil-query-coverage: actual original query support, separate from hydric certainty coverage

attributes.original_metadata: Original column metadata, complete HTTP responses, survey spatial versions and all component rows remain in retained source companions.
attributes.percent_definition: muaggatt.hydclprs is the original map-unit hydric percentage based on component data.
attributes.component_definition: component.hydricrating is an original component Yes/No hydric classification; comppct_r is the original representative component percentage.

hydric_interpretations.selected: hydclprs=100; every original component with positive or unknown comppct_r is hydricrating Yes; at least one such component.
hydric_interpretations.known_negative: hydclprs=0; every original component with positive or unknown comppct_r is hydricrating No; at least one such component.
hydric_interpretations.coverage: Union of confirmed full-hydric and full-nonhydric original map-unit footprints.
hydric_interpretations.mixed_and_unknown: Remain outside certainty coverage, preserving unresolved total acreage where the reporting parcel crosses these units.

hydric_interpretations.coverage: Map units with an original known hydclprs between 0 and 100.
hydric_interpretations.meaning: Whole map-unit footprint under the explicit published predominance interpretation.

hydric_interpretations.coverage: Map units with an original known hydclprs between 0 and 100.
hydric_interpretations.meaning: Whole map-unit footprint with any positive published hydric component share.

transport.selection: Original count and IDs by actual-domain query tiles, then exact native OBJECTID pages
transport.geometry: Original native CRS; original curves plus provider linear representation where needed; all original bodies retained

sources.object_id: Read the actual original esriFieldTypeOID declaration; preserve original values.
sources.crs: Read original source/response spatial-reference metadata; transform an analysis representation to EPSG:4326.
sources.known_negative: Exact SFHA_TF string F in a known mapped zone.
sources.coverage: Union of the actual selected T polygons and actual known mapped F polygons; outside this union remains unresolved.

import_order: Import original classified/source geometry and original response companions
Import selected criterion polygons, binding actual certainty vectors from the first imported source edition
downstream.direct_call: parcel_criteria.prepare(workspace, result['parcel_criteria_selection']) when study_id was selected
downstream.source_choices: result.builder_sources includes actual edition/source/id_field plus retained coverage/reference/meaning; pass the whole choice.
downstream.criterion_table: The maintained builder retains canonical metrics, original native feature IDs, actual coverage, and the parcel/reporting geometry context.
downstream.published_method_location: Lake Keowee Watershed Plan, Appendix D, hydric-soil acreage criterion; printed page140. The plan identifies hydric acreage and source soil GIS, while the selected map-unit percentage interpretation remains explicit in this source edition.

operations.resume: capture(workspace, operation_id, retry_failed=True); original successful responses and complete family checkpoints are reused.
operations.source_refresh: A distinct capture_tag retains a new source operation; reuse_existing=false asks for new source geometry instead of an imported geometry edition.
operations.partial_completion: Completed source families import immediately even if another family remains incomplete. Edition-specific manifests preserve every earlier imported source collection.
operations.empty_positive_selection: An actual empty selected GeoJSON plus a nonempty certainty source can establish zero inside its known coverage.
operations.empty_certainty: No certainty binding is emitted when the actual certainty polygon count is zero.
